steps.message: Connect screen opens and closes Add a Mac
Tap Add a Mac toolbar button
Tap Cancel in Add a Mac sheet
iPad dock - text size, drag to trailing edge, corner orb, floating trackpad
Tap Text size on bottom dock and pick 1 times
Drag dock from Minimize controls to trailing edge (820, 600 pt -> 0.983, 0.496)
Open and close Text size on trailing vertical rail
Minimize to corner orb and expand back
Open and close floating trackpad
iPad chrome launches with its controls
Switcher picks Desktop, then Control Center opens
Tap Apps to open Unified Switcher (triggers known 100% CPU product bug)
Pick Desktop card and return to stream controls
